sections.text:
These trouble 
 shooting will help maintenance staff to overcome most of problems may be 
 occurred during carrying out the maintenance procedure.

rows:
1. When 
 engine is started with compressed air, the Crankshaft does not make full 
 revolution or does not rotate at all.

- shut-off valve or 
 starting or starting air cylinders and starting air pipe closed

- Too low 
 starting air pressure in air cylinders

- Pump 
 air to the required pressure

- Open position or not 
 sealing in hole.

- Examine 
 incorrect valve , release or grind in if required.

2. When 
 started with air, engine develops sufficient speed for starting, but when 
 passing to fuel, does not fire or misses.

- Fuel 
 not supplied to fuel injection pumps.

- Check 
 whether there is fuel in service tank and whether valves are open on fuel 
 line. Fill pipe with fuel and pump the fuel injection pumps. Then move the 
 fuel control fuel to its normal position and bleed the system.

- Air 
 in fuel pipe and pump.

- Bleed 
 fuel injection system, check the screw of injection valve and pump by hand 
 by the fuel injection pump tappet lever.

- Fuel 
 injection valve needle and delivery valve of some cylinder seized, owing 
 to which air penetrated into main pipe.

- Check 
 the beginning of fuel injection.

- Release 
 fuel injection valve needle and delivery valve, or replace.

- Great 
 quantity of water in fuel.

- Drain 
 water from fuel service tank , fuel pipe and cleaner. Fill tank with clean 
 fuel , remove fuel injection valves from cylinders and operate fuel 
 injection pump by hand.

- Governor 
 stuck in stop position and disconnected fuel injection pumps.

- Release 
 governor lever and pull rods, which act, on fuel injection pump. Remove 
 cause of sticking.

- Pressure 
 for fuel atomization not ensured by fuel injection pump.

- Check 
 the pump with pressure , clean valves, or grind in. If pump plunger 
 clearance too great .Replace plunger and cylinder by new fitted ones

- Fuel 
 injection valve needles not sealing in closed position or nozzle holes 
 clogged.

- Disassemble 
 fuel injection valve, grind-in needle, clean nozzle holes or fit new nozzle. 
 When fitting check the spring tension by maximeter and atomization of fuel 
 by a tester.

- Check 
 clearance under exhaust and suction valve rocker arm roller, set the 
 clearance. Check valve tightness. Remove sticking, if any, by grinding in, 
 or replace. Check compression chamber. If gasket between cylinder head and 
 cylinder not sealing, tighten the cylinder head.

- Temperature 
 in engine room too low and engine is cold.

- Warm 
 up cylinders by filling engine with warm water.

- No 
 fuel supplies to the fuel injection pump.

- Check 
 whether there is fuel in service tank and whether valves are open on fuel 
 line. Fill pipe with fuel and pump the fuel injection pumps. Then move the 
 fuel control fuel to its normal position and bleed the system.

- Water 
 in tanks, from which fuel is supplied pumps.

- Drain 
 water and fill main fuel line with clean fuel and operate fuel injection 
 pump by hand with fuel injection valve, check screw open.

- Air 
 in suction chamber of fuel injection pump owing to untight pipe or pump.

- Force 
 air out of the fuel injection pump by pumping fuel by hand with check screw 
 of fuel injection valve open. Remove air leaks in joints.

Exhaust gas temperature 
 rises and exhausts smoke increased.

- Throw 
 load of engine and set speed to rated.

- Fuel 
 injection valve needle cone untight in hole or seizing.

- Grind 
 in needle or replace nozzle.

- Check 
 level of fuel in service tank.

1. Knocks 
 in engine cylinders and moving parts of engine.

- Increased 
 fuel injection advance , increased fuel supply / manifests itself in knocks 
 in cylinder at piston position in T.D.C

- Cut 
 out fuel injection pump of defective cylinders and if knocking stops, reduce 
 injection advance- if exhaust gas temperature was high , reduce fuel feed . 
 If knocking continues after fuel injection advance and fuel feed have been 
 reduced, it may be detonation of fuel, which indicates that fuel of 
 unsuitable grade, is used.

- Fuel 
 injection valve needles seizing / manifests it self in knocks in cylinders 
 at position of piston in T.D.C.

- Check 
 fuel injection valves. Remove defects.

- Main 
 or big end bearing or gudgeon bearing clearance excessive or bolts are 
 loose / manifests itself in dull, increasing or squealing metallic impacts, 
 engine speed remaining constant.

- Stop 
 engine, check clearance and condition of surfaces. If clearances are 
 excessive, the corresponding bearing should be replaced. Replace worn 
 gudgeon pin or shell by new one.

- Worn 
 bearings / knocking of big end bearings, engine speed decreases.

- Stop 
 engine, examine big-end bearings and shaft journals. Remove defects. Mount 
 spare bearing on clean shaft journals. If cracks are found on crankshaft 
 journals, operation of engine is not allowed.

- Large 
 clearance between gear teeth or heavy wear of teeth / manifests itself in 
 knocks in gearing.

- Remove 
 excessive clearance in teeth or replace worn gears.

1. Non 
 uniform operation of individual assemblies.

- In 
 sufficient final compression pressure in some cylinder.

- Check 
 whether gases do not escape in a large amount in some cylinder via piston 
 rings. Turn suction and exhaust valves occasionally to clean seating surface 
 of carbon particles.

- Check 
 pump operation, remove defects. If air penetrates into pump or water 
 penetrates with fuel into the suction space, operate the pump by hand lever, 
 check where air penetrates, remove the defect. Drain water from service tank 
 and cleaner as frequently as possible.

-
 Fuel injection 
 valve needle seizing, due to distortion.

- Disassemble 
 fuel injection valve, remove defect. Check before mounting on engine. Clean 
 fuel injection valve, or replace.

- Great 
 quantity of fuel supplied to cylinder.

- Reduce 
 supply of fuel at fuel injection pump of corresponding cylinder.

- Fuel 
 injection valve needle seizing or nozzle holes clogged.

- Check 
 the fuel injection valve delivery pipe by hand, if hard impacts and abnormal 
 heating are felt, stop engine, clean valve nozzle or replace nozzle and 
 operate fuel injection pump by hand.

- 
 Delivery valve of fuel 
 injection pump leaking or its spring broken.

- Examine 
 and grind in delivery valve , replace spring by new one.

- On 
 the first occasion adjust pressure in cylinder to normal value.

- Injection 
 valve nozzle holes heavily worn.

- A 
 great quantity of oil penetrates into cylinder.

- Scraper 
 rings incorrectly mounted or heavily worn. On the first occasion replace 
 worn rings.

- Low 
 temperature in combustion chamber , some fuel evaporated due to incomplete 
 combustion. Increase load and on the first occasion adjust compression to 
 normal.

- Influent 
 fuel contains water escapes from cylinder heads.

- Drain 
 water from fuel filter and service tank more frequently. Cylinder heads with 
 cracks should be replaced as soon as possible.

-
 Remnant of 
 fuel oil in injection valves before starting due to excessive priming or 
 increased fuel oil supply.

- After 
 closing regulation screws of injection valves prime fuel oil in an amount 
 corresponding to 1-2 measured deliveries check if during turning engine 
 with air fuel oil penetrates into injection valve.

- Combustion 
 pressure higher than normal or safety valve spring tension insufficient if 
 a safety valve blow after each working stroke.

-
 Reduce fuel 
 injection advance and adjust tension of safety valve spring or remove 
 seizing.

- Cylinder 
 overload, water penetrates into cylinder during suction.

- Reduce 
 delivery of fuel, examine and test cylinder head with pressure and if 
 cracks are found replace cylinder head by new one.

- Replace 
 defective nozzle by spares one.

-
 Safety valve on the cylinder head blows

- Check or adjust the 
 combustion pressures. If the combustion pressures are correct, the defect 
 should be looked for in the valve.

- Check 
 level of oil in tank, replenish if necessary, examine suction pipe and all 
 joint. If axial and radial clearance of oil pump gears are too large, 
 remove pump cover and check axial and radial clearance between gears and 
 pump casing. If clearances are too large due to heavy wear of gears, 
 replace gears and remove also other defects which found during inspection.

- Oil 
 pump not developing necessary pressure.

- If 
 oil leaks at delivery pipe/in engine or beyond it/, stop engine, subject 
 pipe to pressure test and simultaneously check main and big-end 
 clearances. If pressure-reducing valve of oil pump does not seal, it is 
 necessary to pass over to the other pump on the engine or a spare pump. On 
 the first occasion examine and check the valves.

- If 
 the difference in pressure gauge readings / pressure gauges before and 
 after cleaner / is small, the cleaner operates correctly. If the 
 difference in pressure before and behind cleaner is too great, the cleaner 
 is choked. Clean the cleaner elements by closing the cock put out cleaner 
 out of service and clean it.

- The 
 presence of water manifests itself in which colour of oil. All the oil 
 should be changed. The cause of the defect should be found and the defect 
 removed. Operation of engine wit oil mixed with water is not allowed.

2.
 High 
 temperature of oil flowing from engine.

- Check 
 oil temperature before and after cooler. Open valve and increase flow of 
 water througt oil cooler.

- Check 
 level of oil in tank, replenish if necessary, examine suction pipe and all 
 joint. If axial and radial clearance of oil pump gears are too large, 
 remove pump cover and check axial and radial clearance between gears and 
 pump casing. If clearances are too large due to heavy wear of gears, 
 replace gears and remove also other defects which found during inspection.

- If 
 oil leaks at delivery pipe/in engine or beyond it/, stop engine, subject 
 pipe to pressure test and simultaneously check main and big-end 
 clearances. If pressure-reducing valve of oil pump does not seal, it is 
 necessary to pass over to the other pump on the engine or a spare pump. On 
 the first occasion examine and check the valves.

- Stop 
 engine, check clearance, mounting of shafts flow of oil through 
 lubricating system and remove defects which have caused bearing 
 temperature rise. Starts engine again and check.

1. Great 
 difference in inlet and outlet water.

-
 Insufficient quantity of water in tank of 
 closed circuit.

- Scales 
 in cooling water spaces in cylinders, in cylinder heads and in water 
 cooler spaces or these spaces are clogged.

- Clean 
 cooling spaces of cylinders, cylinder heads and water cooler.

2. High 
 outlet water temperature of engine.

- Engine 
 over loaded, high exhaust gas temperature.

- Check 
 exhausts gas temperature at individual cylinders and reduce engine speed.

- Take 
 measure to increase water supply.

1. Engine 
 gains speed exceeding the rated value.

- Governor 
 spring controlling fuel oil lever has slipped out.

- Remount 
 spring back in its correct place.

2. Engine 
 operates with great speed variation due to governor being out of order.

- Low 
 lubricating oil temperature at governor inlet less than 20 C.

1. Gas 
 penetrates into the engine casing.

- Stop 
 engine, Pull out the piston, examines piston rings. Replace damaged ones
